source_text: Looks like this clock is powered by batteries. Maybe I could use them.

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Looks like this clock is powered by batteries. Maybe I could use them.
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Looks like this clock is powered by batteries. Maybe I could use them."

translation: Wygląda na to, że ten zegar jest zasilany bateriami. Może mógłbym je wykorzystać.

source_text: Feel free to look around. I have a leak to deal with upstairs.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Feel free to look around. I have a leak to deal with upstairs.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Feel free to look around. I have a leak to deal with upstairs."

translation: Rozgość się. Mam przeciek do ogarnięcia na górze.

source_text: Don’t worry, Father. We won’t disturb your belongings.

structure.raw_value: MeBaOp.Don’t worry, Father. We won’t disturb your belongings.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaOp.Don’t worry, Father. We won’t disturb your belongings."

translation: Nie martw się, ojcze. Nie będziemy ruszać twoich rzeczy.

source_text: It's locked.

structure.raw_value: MeBaDe.It's locked.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaDe.It's locked."

translation: Zamknięte.

source_text: Need help?

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.Need help?
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.Need help?"

translation: Potrzebujesz pomocy?

source_text: Keep an eye on the nun. I can handle this.

structure.raw_value: MeBaEx.Keep an eye on the nun. I can handle this.
structure.script_literal: "MeBaEx.Keep an eye on the nun. I can handle this."

translation: Miej oko na zakonnicę. Ja się tym zajmę.

source_text: Heather…

structure.raw_value: McWoOp.Heather…
structure.script_literal: "McWoOp.Heather…"

translation: Heather…

source_text: 1Hero?

structure.raw_value: HeBaDe.1Hero?
structure.script_literal: "HeBaDe.1Hero?"

translation: 1Hero?

source_text: I didn’t mean anything by what I said.

structure.raw_value: McSaEx.I didn’t mean anything by what I said.
structure.script_literal: "McSaEx.I didn’t mean anything by what I said."

translation: Nie miałem nic złego na myśli w tym, co powiedziałem.

source_text: Am I the only one being hurt by this?

structure.raw_value: HeSaDe.Am I the only one being hurt by this?
structure.script_literal: "HeSaDe.Am I the only one being hurt by this?"

translation: Czy tylko ja cierpię przez to?

source_text: Do you feel hurt?

structure.raw_value: McBaOp.Do you feel hurt?
structure.script_literal: "McBaOp.Do you feel hurt?"

translation: Czy czujesz ból?

source_text: I just… want you.

structure.raw_value: HeSaEx.I just… want you.
structure.script_literal: "HeSaEx.I just… want you."

translation: Ja po prostu… pragnę cię.

source_text: To yourself?

structure.raw_value: McSaDe.To yourself?
structure.script_literal: "McSaDe.To yourself?"

translation: Dla siebie?

source_text: Oh, God. It’s so silly… You are like my time machine…

structure.raw_value: HeSaEx.Oh, God. It’s so silly… You are like my time machine…
structure.script_literal: "HeSaEx.Oh, God. It’s so silly… You are like my time machine…"

translation: O Boże. To takie głupie… Jesteś jak mój wehikuł czasu…

source_text: When we fuck…

structure.raw_value: HeWoEx.When we fuck…
structure.script_literal: "HeWoEx.When we fuck…"

translation: Gdy się pieprzymy…

source_text: Hey, 1Hero. Hello, Miss Wilson.

structure.raw_value: BrHaOp>.Hey, 1Hero. Hello, Miss Wilson.
structure.script_literal: "BrHaOp>.Hey, 1Hero. Hello, Miss Wilson."

translation: Hej, 1Hero. Cześć, panno Wilson.

source_text: Oh, uhhh… Hey, Father.

structure.raw_value: McFrCl.Oh, uhhh… Hey, Father.
structure.script_literal: "McFrCl.Oh, uhhh… Hey, Father."

translation: Och, yyy… Hej, ojcze.

source_text: I was just… Looking for the restroom.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx.I was just… Looking for the restroom.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx.I was just… Looking for the restroom."

translation: Tak tylko… Szukałem toalety.

source_text: Oh! How rude of me. Let me unlock my bathroom…

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx>.Oh! How rude of me. Let me unlock my bathroom…
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx>.Oh! How rude of me. Let me unlock my bathroom… "

translation: Och! Ale ze mnie niegrzeczny. Pozwól, że odblokuję łazienkę…

source_text: I keep it locked so the parishioners don't wander into my medicine cabinet.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx>.I keep it locked so the parishioners don't wander into my medicine cabinet.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx>.I keep it locked so the parishioners don't wander into my medicine cabinet."

translation: Trzymam ją zamkniętą, żeby parafianie nie zaglądali do mojej apteczki.

source_text: Oh, uhh… Thank you, Father.

structure.raw_value: HeFrOp.Oh, uhh… Thank you, Father.
structure.script_literal: "HeFrOp.Oh, uhh… Thank you, Father."

translation: Och, yyy… Dziękuję, ojcze.

source_text: Is everything okay, 1Hero? Our trip to the demon world certainly must have you frazzled.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.Is everything okay, 1Hero? Our trip to the demon world certainly must have you frazzled.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.Is everything okay, 1Hero? Our trip to the demon world certainly must have you frazzled."

translation: Wszystko w porządku, 1Hero? Wyprawa do demonicznego świata musiała cię wykończyć.

source_text: You know… I feel okay.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.You know… I feel okay.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.You know… I feel okay."

translation: Wiesz… Czuję się dobrze.

source_text: Careful, 1Hero. Those monsters will try to manipulate you.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. Those monsters will try to manipulate you.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Careful, 1Hero. Those monsters will try to manipulate you."

translation: Uważaj, 1Hero. Te potwory spróbują tobą manipulować.

source_text: Noted, Father… Are you still studying?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Noted, Father… Are you still studying?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Noted, Father… Are you still studying?"

translation: Przyjęte, ojcze… Nadal się uczysz?

source_text: I feel I’m close to figuring something out, but not sure…

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.I feel I’m close to figuring something out, but not sure…
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.I feel I’m close to figuring something out, but not sure…"

translation: Czuję, że jestem blisko rozgryzienia czegoś, ale nie jestem pewien…

source_text: Well… I better get back to it.

structure.raw_value: BrFrEx.Well… I better get back to it.
structure.script_literal: "BrFrEx.Well… I better get back to it."

translation: Cóż… Lepiej wrócę do tego.

source_text: What the hell is 1Hero doing in there?

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.What the hell is 1Hero doing in there?
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.What the hell is 1Hero doing in there?"

translation: Co, do cholery, 1Hero robi w środku?

source_text: What a nice restroom.

structure.raw_value: CaHaOp.What a nice restroom.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOp.What a nice restroom."

translation: Co za ładna toaleta.

source_text: Oh, yes. I told you it was nice.

structure.raw_value: HeHaEx^.Oh, yes. I told you it was nice.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaEx^.Oh, yes. I told you it was nice."

translation: Och, tak. Mówiłem, że jest ładna.

source_text: And that concludes our tour.

structure.raw_value: McHaDe.And that concludes our tour.
structure.script_literal: "McHaDe.And that concludes our tour."

translation: I to kończy naszą wycieczkę.

source_text: Good golly! Smells like sex in there.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOpNo1.Good golly! Smells like sex in there.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOpNo1.Good golly! Smells like sex in there."

translation: O rany! Śmierdzi tam seksem.

source_text: Hope I didn’t cut you rabbits short.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.Hope I didn’t cut you rabbits short.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.Hope I didn’t cut you rabbits short."

translation: Mam nadzieję, że nie przerwałem wam, króliczki.

source_text: You caught us, Father.

structure.raw_value: CaWoCl.You caught us, Father.
structure.script_literal: "CaWoCl.You caught us, Father."

translation: Przyłapałeś nas, ojcze.

source_text: How about next time use Judy’s bedroom? Quite a bit more comfortable, I would think.

structure.raw_value: BrFlEx.How about next time use Judy’s bedroom? Quite a bit more comfortable, I would think.
structure.script_literal: "BrFlEx.How about next time use Judy’s bedroom? Quite a bit more comfortable, I would think."

translation: Może następnym razem użyjcie sypialni Judy? Znacznie wygodniej, jak sądzę.

source_text: You think the nun would mind some stains on the sheets?

structure.raw_value: CaFlDe.You think the nun would mind some stains on the sheets?
structure.script_literal: "CaFlDe.You think the nun would mind some stains on the sheets?"

translation: Myślisz, że zakonnica miałaby coś przeciwko plamom na prześcieradłach?

source_text: Carol!... How embarrassing.

structure.raw_value: HeWoCl^.Carol!... How embarrassing.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoCl^.Carol!... How embarrassing."

translation: Carol!... Ale wstyd.

source_text: Don’t worry. Brian is cool.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Don’t worry. Brian is cool.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Don’t worry. Brian is cool."

translation: Nie martw się. Brian jest spoko.

source_text: Like I tell 1Hero… It’s not fun unless you get caught from time to time.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Like I tell 1Hero… It’s not fun unless you get caught from time to time.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Like I tell 1Hero… It’s not fun unless you get caught from time to time."

translation: Jak mówię 1Hero… Zabawa jest dopiero wtedy, gdy czasem dacie się złapać.

source_text: I wish I had your outlook on life, Carol.

structure.raw_value: HeWoDe^.I wish I had your outlook on life, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "HeWoDe^.I wish I had your outlook on life, Carol."

translation: Chciałabym mieć twoje podejście do życia, Carol.

source_text: You’ll get there. Just need to get 1Hero to fuck that stick out of your ass.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.You’ll get there. Just need to get 1Hero to fuck that stick out of your ass.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.You’ll get there. Just need to get 1Hero to fuck that stick out of your ass."

translation: Dojdziesz do tego. Musisz tylko pozwolić 1Hero wyruchać ten kij z twojej dupy.

source_text: Uhh… I don’t think that’s how the saying goes.

structure.raw_value: McWoCl.Uhh… I don’t think that’s how the saying goes.
structure.script_literal: "McWoCl.Uhh… I don’t think that’s how the saying goes."

translation: Yyy… Nie sądzę, że tak to przysłowie brzmi.

source_text: Hey. Someone’s got to look out for us.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx^.Hey. Someone’s got to look out for us.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx^.Hey. Someone’s got to look out for us."

translation: Hej. Ktoś musi na nas uważać.

source_text: Haha. A lot of good it did.

structure.raw_value: CaHaOpNo3.Haha. A lot of good it did.
structure.script_literal: "CaHaOpNo3.Haha. A lot of good it did."

translation: Haha. Na wiele się to zdało.

source_text: Come on. Let’s go chat.

structure.raw_value: HeFlEx^.Come on. Let’s go chat.
structure.script_literal: "HeFlEx^.Come on. Let’s go chat."

translation: Chodźmy. Pogadajmy.

source_text: Can I come?

structure.raw_value: McFrOp.Can I come?
structure.script_literal: "McFrOp.Can I come?"

translation: Mogę iść?

source_text: 1Hero! This is girl talk time.

structure.raw_value: CaFrEx.1Hero! This is girl talk time.
structure.script_literal: "CaFrEx.1Hero! This is girl talk time."

translation: 1Hero! Teraz czas na babskie pogaduchy.

source_text: Well… What’s left to tease me about? I’ve done it all with you ladies… and your daughters.

structure.raw_value: McFlDe.Well… What’s left to tease me about? I’ve done it all with you ladies… and your daughters.
structure.script_literal: "McFlDe.Well… What’s left to tease me about? I’ve done it all with you ladies… and your daughters."

translation: Cóż… Co jeszcze możecie ze mnie zadrwić? Robiłem już wszystko z wami babkami… i waszymi córkami.

source_text: Don’t worry. I’m sure we can find lots of stuff to talk about.

structure.raw_value: CaFlEx.Don’t worry. I’m sure we can find lots of stuff to talk about.
structure.script_literal: "CaFlEx.Don’t worry. I’m sure we can find lots of stuff to talk about."

translation: Nie martw się. Na pewno znajdziemy mnóstwo tematów.

source_text: Hehe! Oh, Carol.

structure.raw_value: HeHaOpNo3^.Hehe! Oh, Carol.
structure.script_literal: "HeHaOpNo3^.Hehe! Oh, Carol."

translation: Hehe! Och, Carol.

source_text: You’re saying a police officer found Sister Judy and Kimberly near the rift?

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.You’re saying a police officer found Sister Judy and Kimberly near the rift?
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.You’re saying a police officer found Sister Judy and Kimberly near the rift?"

translation: Mówisz, że policjant znalazł siostrę Judy i Kimberly przy Szczelinie?

source_text: I sent him there… Bobby Rinaldi… He’s keeping them at the mansion.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I sent him there… Bobby Rinaldi… He’s keeping them at the mansion.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I sent him there… Bobby Rinaldi… He’s keeping them at the mansion."

translation: Wysłałem go tam… Bobby Rinaldi… Trzyma je w rezydencji.

source_text: What about the demons? Did he see them?

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe^.What about the demons? Did he see them?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe^.What about the demons? Did he see them?"

translation: A co z demonami? Widział je?

source_text: They are not with the girls. The girls are alone.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.They are not with the girls. The girls are alone.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.They are not with the girls. The girls are alone."

translation: Nie ma ich z dziewczynami. Dziewczyny są same.

source_text: We have to get over there and save them.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.We have to get over there and save them.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.We have to get over there and save them."

translation: Musimy tam iść i je uratować.

source_text: Hold on, Father… It might be a trap.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Hold on, Father… It might be a trap.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Hold on, Father… It might be a trap."

translation: Poczekaj, ojcze… To może być pułapka.

source_text: You think Lilith is trying to lure the priest into a trap?

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe^.You think Lilith is trying to lure the priest into a trap?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe^.You think Lilith is trying to lure the priest into a trap?"

translation: Myślisz, że Lilith próbuje zwabić księdza w pułapkę?

source_text: Isn’t it just too convenient?

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.Isn’t it just too convenient?
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.Isn’t it just too convenient?"

translation: Czy to nie zbyt wygodne?

source_text: Still awake?

structure.raw_value: NeBaDe.Still awake?
structure.script_literal: "NeBaDe.Still awake?"

translation: Jeszcze nie śpisz?

source_text: We’ve found Sister Judy.

structure.raw_value: McWoEx.We’ve found Sister Judy.
structure.script_literal: "McWoEx.We’ve found Sister Judy."

translation: Znaleźliśmy siostrę Judy.

source_text: Huh? Where is she?

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp^.Huh? Where is she?
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp^.Huh? Where is she?"

translation: Huh? Gdzie ona jest?

source_text: At the mansion, alongside Kimberly Foxx.

structure.raw_value: HrBaEx^.At the mansion, alongside Kimberly Foxx.
structure.script_literal: "HrBaEx^.At the mansion, alongside Kimberly Foxx."

translation: W rezydencji, wraz z Kimberly Foxx.

source_text: We must save them!

structure.raw_value: ArWoOp.We must save them!
structure.script_literal: "ArWoOp.We must save them!"

translation: Musimy je uratować!

source_text: I sense a trap… Lillian knows that Father Solomon would go after them.

structure.raw_value: McBaDe.I sense a trap… Lillian knows that Father Solomon would go after them.
structure.script_literal: "McBaDe.I sense a trap… Lillian knows that Father Solomon would go after them."

translation: Wyczuwam pułapkę… Lillian wie, że ojciec Solomon poszedłby po nie.

source_text: You can’t just leave them there.

structure.raw_value: ElWoOp^.You can’t just leave them there.
structure.script_literal: "ElWoOp^.You can’t just leave them there."

translation: Nie możesz ich tam zostawić.

source_text: Arianna and I will go get them and bring them back here… The crosses will protect them.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Arianna and I will go get them and bring them back here… The crosses will protect them.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Arianna and I will go get them and bring them back here… The crosses will protect them."

translation: Arianna i ja po nie pójdziemy i przyprowadzimy je tutaj… Krzyże je ochronią.

source_text: Let's hurry before Lilith finds them.

structure.raw_value: ArWoEx.Let's hurry before Lilith finds them.
structure.script_literal: "ArWoEx.Let's hurry before Lilith finds them."

translation: Pospieszmy się, zanim Lilith je znajdzie.

source_text: Bobby said the portal closed. But we should hurry.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.Bobby said the portal closed. But we should hurry.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.Bobby said the portal closed. But we should hurry."

translation: Bobby powiedział, że portal się zamknął. Ale powinniśmy się pospieszyć.

source_text: Same here. I can help.

structure.raw_value: NeFrEx.Same here. I can help.
structure.script_literal: "NeFrEx.Same here. I can help."

translation: Ja też mogę pomóc.

source_text: What about the cops? Will they let you in?

structure.raw_value: HrBaDe^.What about the cops? Will they let you in?
structure.script_literal: "HrBaDe^.What about the cops? Will they let you in?"

translation: A co z glinami? Wpuszczą cię?

source_text: Bobby will let us in. He trusts me now.

structure.raw_value: McFrEx.Bobby will let us in. He trusts me now.
structure.script_literal: "McFrEx.Bobby will let us in. He trusts me now."

translation: Bobby mnie wpuści. Teraz mi ufa.

source_text: I just hope Sister Judy is okay… Lilith did a number on her.

structure.raw_value: BrWoOp.I just hope Sister Judy is okay… Lilith did a number on her.
structure.script_literal: "BrWoOp.I just hope Sister Judy is okay… Lilith did a number on her."

translation: Mam tylko nadzieję, że siostra Judy jest cała… Lilith nieźle ją sponiewierała.

source_text: I can bless them… I can undo the brainwashing Lilith has put upon them.

structure.raw_value: ArFrEx.I can bless them… I can undo the brainwashing Lilith has put upon them.
structure.script_literal: "ArFrEx.I can bless them… I can undo the brainwashing Lilith has put upon them."

translation: Mogę je pobłogosławić… Mogę cofnąć pranie mózgu, które nałożyła na nie Lilith.

source_text: Come on… new Madalyn. I’ll show you the way.

structure.raw_value: NeFlEx.Come on… new Madalyn. I’ll show you the way.
structure.script_literal: "NeFlEx.Come on… new Madalyn. I’ll show you the way."

translation: Chodź… nowa Madalyn. Pokażę ci drogę.

source_text: Bring them back safe.

structure.raw_value: BrBaDe.Bring them back safe.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaDe.Bring them back safe."

translation: Przyprowadź je bezpiecznie.

source_text: I’m going to talk to Bobby… He’ll let us search the mansion… He has to.

structure.raw_value: McBaEx.I’m going to talk to Bobby… He’ll let us search the mansion… He has to.
structure.script_literal: "McBaEx.I’m going to talk to Bobby… He’ll let us search the mansion… He has to."

translation: Porozmawiam z Bobbym… Pozwoli nam przeszukać rezydencję… Musi.

source_text: I don’t trust cops, but we need to be able to search that mansion.

structure.raw_value: HrAnDe^.I don’t trust cops, but we need to be able to search that mansion.
structure.script_literal: "HrAnDe^.I don’t trust cops, but we need to be able to search that mansion."

translation: Nie ufam glinom, ale musimy mieć możliwość przeszukania rezydencji.

source_text: Get a few hours of rest, Henry… I’ll try and do the same.

structure.raw_value: BrBaEx.Get a few hours of rest, Henry… I’ll try and do the same.
structure.script_literal: "BrBaEx.Get a few hours of rest, Henry… I’ll try and do the same."

translation: Odpocznij kilka godzin, Henry… Ja spróbuję zrobić to samo.

source_text: Diana and I can find those amulets… We’re built for this.

structure.raw_value: HrFrEx^.Diana and I can find those amulets… We’re built for this.
structure.script_literal: "HrFrEx^.Diana and I can find those amulets… We’re built for this."

translation: Diana i ja możemy znaleźć te amulety… Jesteśmy do tego stworzeni.
